question.text: Which of the following compounds will behave as reducing sugar in an aqueous <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>KOH</mi></math> solution?

solution.text: Sugar has an ester functional group <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>CO</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>, which gets hydrolyzed in an alkaline medium to give hemi-acetal, which then acts as a reducing sugar.
